name: agentic-midas
description: Midas team workflows on Azure DevOps: create and refine work items in the team format, develop user stories end to end with approval gates (/feature) or through a 14-phase file-based development workflow adapted from maister (/develop) or a quick TDD bug fix (/quick-bugfix), set up .midas/docs from the code, the ADRs and past PR reviews (/init, /adr-distill, /standards-discover), and create test cases in the team's Midas_Stories test plan. Read-only ADO tools run freely; every change is asked first.
